name: Level-wise Texture Merging
definition: A technique to minimize texture memory overhead by merging texture data of adjacent bricks into a single texture map, creating an octree-like hierarchy where the number of bricks sharing a texture map is multiplied by a factor of 8 on each consecutive level.
summary: Level-wise Texture Merging reduces memory overhead in hierarchical volume rendering by grouping eight adjacent bricks into a single shared texture map at each level.
